source: effective dashboard and external worker STARLI_RUNTIME_CODE_DIR

dashboardEnvironment.STARLI_DASHBOARD_ROOT: absolute path to dashboard (optional in this source layout)
dashboardEnvironment.STARLI_STATE_DIR: fresh absolute private per-instance state directory

optionalOperatorConfiguration: STARLI_MANAGED_ENV_FILE (explicit private operator env file; no production fallback)
STARLI_PI_MODULE_PATH (module file URL override; default resolves installed package)
PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR (private Pi state; no existing auth files supplied)

privateStorage.windows: current-user owned, protected owner-only DACL; LocalSystem allowed; reject inherited broad access, reparse points and hardlinks
privateStorage.posix: current uid, owner-only file/directory modes, no symlink and single-link regular file
privateStorage.lock: bounded stdlib msvcrt first-byte exclusive lock on Windows; nonblocking fcntl exclusive lock on POSIX; max30s wait in helper
privateStorage.refresh: encrypted SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; merge only when selected stored credential still matches original
